Subject: Your anticipatory bail matter

Dear Ms. Mukherjee,

Thank you for meeting us on 27 February 2021 about your dispute with Harish More. As we understand it, the complainant alleges cheating over a failed deal.

Our advice is to produce the contract and payment records to show there was no intent to cheat at the outset. Please collect the signed contract and the payment records and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of Rs 74,80,000.

Regards,
Adv. Hema Lakshmanan
